svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 970 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-22 through 2026-11-13 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-13T18:19:09.320Z.
